name: Dementation (Dark Ages) — 3 Advanced — Kiss of the Moon

system.description: With Kiss of the Moon, you can lead another away from the clutches of sanity permanently, twisting the essence of the victim. Converse with your victim for a turn, then expend a Willpower Trait and enter a Social Challenge with him. If you win, choose a derangement for your victim; this derangement becomes a permanent part of the victim's mind for the rest of his existence. As part of the cruel irony of Dementation, derangements granted by Kiss of the Moon do not allow a Cainite to learn Dementation from them; he must derive at least some of his madness from some other source. Whether Kiss of the Moon can be used to remove the derangements it bestows is up to the Storyteller.
